title: Race, Racism and Ethnicity in Canada since 1900
description: Surveys the place and meanings of race and ethnicity in Canada since 1900. Explores state and dominant ideologies as well as the experiences of Indigenous Peoples, immigrants and of community development using film, fiction and popular, social and political histories. Topics may include histories of dispossession, exclusion, racism, and antisemitism as well as narratives of resistance, survival and resurgence.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of HSTR 329B, HIST 358 (if taken in the same topic), HIST 358D (if taken in Sep 1989 - Aug 2001), HIST 358G, HIST 359 (if taken in the same topic).
